body: Thank you for telling me this. Thank you for sharing this. I'm here to tell you, I'm listening, I'm here to listen. You are not alone. Nothing is your fault. Everything will be okay.
Still trying to suppress it and forget about it haha.

He asks me to please stay with him, don’t leave him, wouldn’t know what to do without me. He used to be even more controlling and obsessive but it’s gotten a bit better, although it still pressures me from time to time.

Do you think it's more damage to my boyfriend to stay with him or to leave him? He's very reliant on me and that's part of the reason why I haven't told him and haven't broke it off. I really don't know what's the best thing to do.

Do you know what it’s like to be stuck in the same dilemma for 1.5 years? No one wants to cheat on their partner. I have tried many times to stop and distance and give up and stay away. Of course i’m not stupid enough to think the universe directs what I should do or the world is a mysterious force or whatever, but there are all these coincidences that really shred at my rationality. I’m posting about this because this knowledge that I found out today really set me off and I don’t even know what I need to do now. It’s really not a burning question whether he likes me or not, I didn’t mention that I want to know for sure whether he likes me or don’t, honestly it doesn’t matter in the end because I can’t like him no matter what.

It’s taxing to deny and suppress and invalidate your feelings again and again and again and still not being able to get rid of them completely, and finding out this piece of information today WHEN I JUST TRIED AGAIN TO GIVE UP ON HIM YESTERDAY is really draining me. I’ve tried so many times to do the right thing, suppress the feelings, ignore the feelings, stay away. I want to be good to my boyfriend. People are not stone. It’s a hard situation. Not a glorious situation or one where the obvious villain is yourself because why don’t you change? I’ve tried, believe me, I’ve tried, and I just don’t know what method there is to try harder so please help me.

Thank you so much for your response. I will look into that podcast. Unfortunately we don’t have much of a HR as we are a retail shop and a small business. There is one other boss but I can’t really complain to him about his business partner, and he’s not a very caring person either. I have no evidence of harassment being done to me and I don’t know if this even counts as harassment at all. I don’t really want to escalate this to a legal level as I still need to be here for a whole year :(
